description: The file defines the AOS_Contracts class, which extends AOS_Contracts_sugar, and implements business logic for handling contracts in the SuiteCRM system, including creation of reminders, saving, deletion, and linking to calls.

classes.name: AOS_Contracts
classes.description: Represents contract records in SuiteCRM, providing methods for managing contract-related processes such as reminders, linking to calls, and deletion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new contract object, setting default renewal reminder date based on end date and configured reminder period.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the contract record, handling related data such as product groups and renewal reminders.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the contract as deleted and deletes associated product lines and calls.

methods.name: createReminder
methods.description: Creates a call reminder for contract renewal based on renewal_reminder_date.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates or updates a link (call) to the related account for renewal reminders.

methods.name: deleteCall
methods.description: Deletes the related call associated with the contract.
